findings.title: Ancilla carries information about the computation
findings.description: Partial-trace analysis shows ancilla qubit(s) [1, 2] are NOT independent of the data qubits (ancilla reduced states differ by up to 1.00e+00 (trace distance) across 2 probe inputs). Information is leaking out of the computation.
findings.remediation: Remove or re-derive the ancilla; audit what it is entangled with and where it is measured.
